bad.title: A blink where the results go
bad.text: At 0.3 s the spinner is gone before anyone can read “Searching…”, so it looks like a glitch.

bad.title: Spinner shown, even at 0.3 s
bad.text: Press Chairs and the line below admits it. Every fast search pays for a flash.

good.title: Fast results just appear
good.text: The old list swaps straight to the new one, with no flash in between.

good.title: No spinner at 0.3 s
good.text: The line below confirms it, so fast searches feel as fast as they are.

good.title: Slow network still gets one
good.text: At 2 s the spinner shows after 400 ms, so it means a real wait.

bad.title: Uploading video… and nothing else
bad.text: No percent and no time left, so a minute of this looks like a stuck upload.
bad.wait: Press Upload video to see this.

bad.title: Only the clock moves
bad.text: Time so far keeps climbing, but nothing says how much is left.

good.title: A bar that fills with the work
good.text: It moves every second, so people can see the upload is alive.
good.wait: Press Upload video to see this.

good.title: GB sent and seconds left
good.text: “1.1 of 6.5 GB · about 50 s left” lets people choose to wait or step away.
good.wait: Press Upload video to see this.

bad.title: A cover over the whole app
bad.text: Everything goes gray for four seconds, though only the folder list is loading.

bad.title: The reply stops taking keys
bad.text: Someone halfway through “book a table for” has to wait for a folder count.

good.title: Loading folders…, right where it’s busy
good.text: The spinner sits in the folder list, so people see what’s loading and what isn’t.

good.title: The reply keeps taking text
good.text: People can finish the sentence while the folders load.

bad.title: One short row for three files
bad.text: The spinner holds a fraction of the height the list will need.

bad.title: Upload file drops a whole list
bad.text: Anyone reaching for it during loading clicks a file row instead.

good.title: Three placeholder rows for three files
good.text: Each has the thumbnail and line of a real row, so the height is right.

good.title: Upload file stays where it was
good.text: Same spot before and after the files land, so a click always hits it.

bad.title: Empty until it’s suddenly full
bad.text: The bar jumps from nothing to 100%, with no sign of life in between.

bad.title: 0% for six seconds
bad.text: The number never moves, so working and stuck look the same.

good.title: A bar that keeps moving
good.text: The stripe runs the whole time, so people see the restore is alive.

good.title: Step 1 of 3, not 0%
good.text: People see how many stages there are and which one they’re in.

good.title: Finished stages get a check
good.text: Checking files ticks off and Copying turns bold, so it’s plainly getting somewhere.
good.wait: Press Restore and wait two seconds to see this.

bad.title: 99% after one second
bad.text: It races through 30, 62, 85 and 96, then sits at 99 for four seconds.
bad.wait: Press Export album to see this.

bad.title: The clock shows the stall
bad.text: Time keeps running while the bar doesn’t, so people think it froze.
bad.wait: Press Export album to see this.

good.title: One photo at a time
good.text: Photo 12 of 30 is real work, so the bar moves at the pace of the export.
good.wait: Press Export album to see this.

good.title: Finishing up… with a moving bar
good.text: The part that can’t be counted says so instead of posing as 99%.
good.wait: Press Export album and wait four seconds to see this.

bad.title: A dialog over the whole editor
bad.text: Title and clips are out of reach for six seconds.

bad.title: No way to stop it
bad.text: Nothing here cancels, so a wrong export runs to the end.

good.title: A small strip at the bottom
good.text: The percent shows here without covering the title or the clips.

good.title: Cancel right beside the bar
good.text: One press stops it, and the editor says Export canceled.

good.title: Still editable while it runs
good.text: People can rename the video or pick a clip, and hear back when it’s ready.

bad.title: A tiny bar labeled Status
bad.text: It sits under the list, with no file name and no number.

bad.title: trip-video.mov already looks done
bad.text: It shows 3 GB like any finished file while the upload is still running.
bad.wait: Press Upload trip-video.mov to see this.

good.title: The bar is on the file
good.text: People looking at trip-video.mov see how far it has got.
good.wait: Press Upload trip-video.mov to see this.

good.title: GB sent, next to the name
good.text: “0.9 of 3 GB” is an amount people can judge at a glance.
good.wait: Press Upload trip-video.mov to see this.

good.title: 1 uploading in the top bar
good.text: A summary that stays in view, then turns into Uploaded.
good.wait: Press Upload trip-video.mov to see this.

bad.title: Text lines where photos go
bad.text: They’re far shorter than the grid, so the space is wrong from the start.

bad.title: Share album drops when photos land
bad.text: Anyone reaching for it during the reload clicks empty space.

good.title: Six tiles in the grid’s shape
good.text: Same rows, same size, so nothing below has to move.

good.title: Share album stays put
good.text: The note under the frame says “Share album didn’t move” once the photos arrive.

bad.title: Gray bars for a blink
bad.text: Each switch flashes empty rows that are gone before they read as loading.

bad.title: Every tab switch flickers
bad.text: Going back and forth makes the list flash each time, so the app feels jumpy.

good.title: The list just swaps
good.text: Playlists turns straight into Albums, so the switch feels instant.

good.title: Held back for 400 ms
good.text: Placeholders would show only if loading ran slow, so a quick tab never flickers.

bad.title: Still loading, forever
bad.text: The gray rows look the same at 2 seconds and at 2 minutes.

bad.title: Only the demo knows it failed
bad.text: This line is behind the scenes. People on the page see no change.
bad.wait: Wait two seconds to see this.

good.title: Couldn’t load your inbox, said plainly
good.text: It takes the place of the gray rows and points to the connection.
good.wait: Wait two seconds to see this.

good.title: Retry right under the message
good.text: One press loads the inbox, with no need to reload the page.
good.wait: Wait two seconds to see this.

bad.title: Even the account name shimmers
bad.text: “Everyday account” is already known, yet it stays hidden until everything arrives.

bad.title: Fast shimmer on every row
bad.text: Every block flashes for 2.6 seconds, which is tiring to watch.

good.title: Everyday account, at once
good.text: The name and Last 7 days show right away, so people know where they are.

good.title: The balance comes next
good.text: $2,480.16 lands after 0.7 s, well before the transactions.
good.wait: Press Reload and wait a moment to see this.

good.title: Only the rows still loading pulse
good.text: Slow and soft, so the waiting part is clear without pulling at the eye.
